normalized.result: I'd go with the **compact expandable version**. The whole value of my list is being able to run my eye down it and find things quickly, and if one bookmark has a giant title and a rambling description, letting it sprawl across the screen would shove everything else down and make the list a chore to scan. I'd rather each item stay to a tidy, predictable size so the list reads cleanly — and then, for the odd long one, "Show full details" lets me open it up and read the whole thing when I actually want to. So keep the everyday list neat and uniform, with the full text one click away. That's the treatment to use.
